chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Saeed from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa from Ammar ibn Musa from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

When it is the last night of the month of Ramadan, say: 'O Allah, this is the month of Ramadan in which You revealed the Quran, and it is coming to an end, and I seek refuge with Your noble Face, O Lord, lest the dawn rise from this night of mine, or the month of Ramadan pass away, while there is a debt or sin against me for which You intend to punish me on the Day I meet You.'

key_terms.تَصَرَّمَ: Passed away / came to an end

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for the last night of Ramadan?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this supplication emphasizes the concept of 'Tabi'ah' (accountability or debt) owed to Allah, reflecting the Shia scholarly focus on meticulous self-examination before the month's conclusion. It serves as a spiritual preparation for Laylat al-Qadr, urging the believer to seek refuge from any unatoned sins that might result in divine punishment upon meeting Allah.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yaham from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever it is the last night of the Month of Ramazan, so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! This is the Month in which the Quran was Revealed, and it is ending, and I hereby seek Refuge with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Benevolent Face, O Lord, that the dawn emerges from this night of mine, or the Month of Ramazan comes to an end, and to You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Acceptance of my repentance, or sins Repelled which You<sup>azwj</sup> would be Punishing me with on the Day I meet You<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar ibn Musa who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that during the last night of the month of Ramadan, say this prayer.

‘O Allah, this is the month of Ramadan when You revealed the Holy Quran, and now it has ended. I seek refuge with Your honorable face, against my remaining in a condition, O Lord, that this night ends up with dawn or the month of Ramadan ends up, but You will have (in record) against me consequences (of my deeds) or sins for which You want to punish me on the day I am brought in your presence.’”
